recommendations.title: Keep .aide/reports flat for now
recommendations.reason: The inventory found 365 flat check/accept report path references across 156 files.
recommendations.next_step: Build a report index before proposing any report directory migration.

recommendations.title: Keep core/protocol flat for now
recommendations.reason: The directory has 10 tracked files and still maps cleanly to current protocol helpers.
recommendations.next_step: Revisit only after ConformanceProfile, PatchTransaction, AdapterManifest, or ContextPack adds real import pressure.

recommendations.title: Treat duplicate names as authority boundaries, not errors
recommendations.reason: .aide and core intentionally duplicate names such as protocol, knowledge, providers, gateway, compat, apply, and tests.
recommendations.next_step: Document source/state/helper boundaries before any movement.

recommendations.title: Classify tracked .aide/tmp files before cleanup
recommendations.reason: Tracked .aide/tmp files appear to be fixture-like WorkUnit CLI mutation inputs.
recommendations.next_step: Review whether they belong under fixtures, .aide/examples, or a task-local evidence path.

recommendations.title: Do not create top-level tools, tests, examples, or archive yet
recommendations.reason: .aide already has tools, tests, and examples subtrees, while root-authority policy marks top-level roots as add-only candidates.
recommendations.next_step: Use a separate design task before adding any of those roots.

rationalization_prompt_gate: Generate only after inventory check and acceptance review.
